reviewer: Codex agent rendered-image inspection, not human playtesting
visual_findings: Front silhouette meets fixed-reference forms thresholds. Side and rear remain generated inference.
Front face, pocket tools, five-finger separation and clothing identity read at detail scale.
Extreme poses show no obvious open holes or collapsed elbows/knees; overhead hands are above the head.
Cloth and skin show source PBR response in Blender; Godot TextureToon is a separate render condition.
At the 45-degree elevated 128px town approximation, clothing/hair/stance read; facial details are small.
incomplete_acceptance: Six facial controls, blinking/closed sleep eyes and facial gaze are absent.
Hair aging requires an explicit mask, material or replacement mesh.
Inherited FK gait has variable support velocity; best-fit speed does not prove no sliding.
Actual Godot table/cup/chair/bed contacts and LOD performance are verified separately.
One frontal concept does not validate side/back anatomy.
evidence_kind: Local asset-production evidence; not a final character-quality or fun acceptance.
